  • Take ownership and responsibility over the financial progress of assigned tasks.
  • Understand and apply project management concepts providing feedback to project manager, serve as reference for the escalation of issues.
  • Manage simple projects assigned applying project management concepts and techniques.
  • Assess minor structural problems for internal/external clients to determine solutions with minimal supervision.
  • Answer contractor questions on behalf of the supervising engineer, and serve as liaisons between engineering and construction personnel.

Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering General

Qualifications

  • Experience in ship stability analysis, preferably within a class society, shipbuilding, or maritime consultancy.
  • In-depth knowledge of stability regulations, including IMO codes, classification society rules, and international maritime safety conventions related to ship stability.
  • Expertise in stability calculations, including intact stability, damage stability, and parametric rolling analysis, using hydrodynamic software and engineering tools.
  • Proficiency in interpreting and approving stability plans, ensuring ships meet regulatory requirements and classification standards.
  • Experience in evaluating stability conditions for both new builds and retrofit projects, with the ability to suggest improvements or modifications when necessary.
  • Strong understanding of ship design and how structural elements (e.g., cargo holds, ballast systems) affect overall stability.
  • Ability to collaborate with design teams, surveyors, and shipbuilders to ensure the correct implementation of stability plans.
  • Familiarity with ship operational parameters and understanding how stability is impacted by various operational scenarios, including ballast water management and loading/unloading procedures.
  • Strong communication and reporting skills for producing clear and concise stability assessment reports for clients and stakeholders.

Um vendedor de loja desempenha um papel crucial em garantir que os clientes tenham uma experiência de compra satisfatória e eficiente.

As principais responsabilidades de um vendedor incluem:

  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Receber e saudar os clientes, oferecer assistência na escolha de produtos, responder a perguntas e fornecer informações detalhadas sobre itens e promoções.
  • Apresentação e Demonstração de Produtos: Mostrar produtos aos clientes, explicar suas características e benefícios, e fazer recomendações com base nas necessidades e preferências dos clientes.
  • Processamento de Vendas: Ajudar no processo de checkout, que pode incluir operar a caixa registradora ou sistema de ponto de venda (PDV), embalar produtos e realizar transações de pagamento.
  • Gestão de Estoque: Monitorar níveis de estoque, reabastecer prateleiras e expositores, e garantir que os produtos estejam sempre disponíveis e bem apresentados.
  • Organização da Loja: Manter a loja limpa e organizada, rearranjar produtos e garantir que a área de vendas esteja sempre atraente e acessível para os clientes.
  • Promoções e Ofertas: Informar os clientes sobre promoções e ofertas especiais, e incentivá-los a aproveitar essas oportunidades.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Lidar com reclamações e problemas dos clientes de maneira eficiente e profissional, buscando soluções que atendam às necessidades dos clientes e mantenham a boa reputação da loja.
  • Atingir Metas de Vendas: Trabalhar para atingir ou superar as metas de vendas estabelecidas pela loja, usando técnicas de vendas e estratégias para maximizar as oportunidades.
  • Atualização e Treinamento: Manter-se atualizado sobre os produtos, tendências de mercado e políticas da loja, participando de treinamentos e reuniões conforme necessário.
  • Feedback e Melhoria Contínua: Fornecer feedback à gerência sobre as necessidades dos clientes e quaisquer problemas que possam impactar a experiência de compra, contribuindo para melhorias contínuas na operação da loja.

Essas responsabilidades ajudam a criar uma experiência de compra positiva, aumentar as vendas e fortalecer o relacionamento com os clientes, o que é essencial para o sucesso de nossas lojas.

title: Técnico em Laboratório
description:
Vaga para Técnico em Laboratório

Descrição

Vita Check-up

Se você é apaixonada por cuidar de pessoas, tem atenção aos detalhes e busca oferecer um atendimento excepcional em saúde preventiva, essa vaga é para você!

Sobre a vaga: Buscamos uma Técnica de Patologia qualificada, dedicada e com boa comunicação para integrar nossa equipe multidisciplinar. Você será responsável por promover o encantamento do cliente por meio da condução segura, humanizada e eficiente dos processos de assistência, coleta de exames laboratoriais, preparo e envio de amostras, avaliações de bioimpedância e demais procedimentos de preparo para o check‑up. Atuar na prevenção e solução de intercorrências, assegurando excelência na experiência do cliente, mantendo a liderança informada e solicitando providências quando necessário. Prestar assistência às necessidades básicas dos clientes (higiene, conforto e apoio emocional), zelando continuamente por sua segurança e bem‑estício durante toda a jornada no serviço.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Realizar coleta de exames laboratoriais, incluindo punção venosa para coleta de sangue, seguindo protocolos técnicos e de biossegurança.
  • Executar avaliações de bioimpedância e outros procedimentos de preparo dos clientes para exames.
  • Preparar amostras biológicas para envio à análise técnica, incluindo identificação, centrifugação, acondicionamento, armazenamento e rastreabilidade.
  • Cadastrar informações de exames nos sistemas laboratoriais, de imagem e demais avaliações, garantindo fluxo ágil e seguro de atendimento.
  • Acompanhar e prestar apoio aos clientes durante a realização do check‑up, oferecendo orientações e suporte sempre que necessário.
  • Organizar salas de atendimento, conferindo formulários, equipamentos e materiais, inclusive controle de validade.
  • Avaliar necessidade de materiais permanentes (ex.: braçadeira de PNI, cabos, sensores) e descartáveis, solicitando reposição e preenchendo check‑lists.
  • Executar limpeza, desinfecção e esterilização de equipamentos e superfícies, conforme protocolos institucionais.
  • Zelar pelo uso adequado e conservação dos equipamentos, comunicando anormalidades à liderança imediata.
  • Cumprir estratégias e diretrizes da Diretoria, participando de reuniões e rituais de gestão quando solicitado.

Competências funcionais e técnicas

  • Conhecimento e experiência em coleta de sangue e demais exames laboratoriais.
  • Domínio dos processos de preparo de amostras biológicas (centrifugação, identificação, acondicionamento e envio).
  • Conhecimento de biossegurança e uso adequado de EPIs conforme NR‑32.
  • Noções de atendimento humanizado ao cliente em ambiente de saúde.
  • Capacidade de registro correto de informações em sistemas.
  • Capacidade de se expressar corretamente verbal e na escrita.

Competências comportamentais

  • Comunicação e capacidade para lidar com conflitos: Habilidade de construir e manter relacionamentos dentro e fora do setor Operacional. Clareza oral e escrita, capacidade de expressar suas ideias. Capacidade para ouvir e entender a necessidade dos clientes externos e internos das demais áreas do negócio.
  • Iniciativa: proatividade para identificar riscos e propor melhorias nos processos.
  • Trabalho em equipe: trabalha cooperativamente, integrando pessoas e gerando uma ambiência de trabalho produtivo e colaborativo.
  • Adaptação à mudança: entendimento e capacidade de ajustar às prioridades, direcionamentos e conjuntura. Flexibilidade para mudança de acordo com o ambiente. Habilidade para reconhecer problemas e propor soluções.

Requisitos

  • Curso Técnico em Análises Clínicas, Patologia Clínica, Laboratório ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento em informática básica.

description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

The Technical Implementation Specialist is responsible for bridging the gap between our core LPPA extraction tool engine and our clients’ downstream internal systems. You are essentially the “Last Mile” problem solver. While our platform excels at turning unstructured investment documents into structured data, our clients cannot realize the full value of that data if it doesn't “talk” to their existing downstream systems (like eFront, Investran, or internal ERPs).

You will be responsible for solving the “Last Mile” delivery problem—ensuring that the data we extract is not just accurate, but immediately actionable within the client’s unique technical ecosystem. This involves navigating complex data mapping, managing secure connectivity across diverse IT infrastructures, and acting as the go‑to for delivering bespoke integration solutions in the template the client needs under tight deadlines.

The team's core mission is to solve the “Last Mile” problem in data delivery and utilization, specifically focusing on custom integration. Our platform excels at transforming unstructured investment documents into structured data. However, this data only achieves its full value when it seamlessly integrates with a client's existing downstream systems (such as eFront, Investran, or internal ERPs). The Custom Integration Lead acts as the crucial bridge between our core data extraction engine and these client‑specific systems. This role is responsible for ensuring the extracted data is immediately actionable within the client’s unique technical environment.

This Involves

  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for new clients requiring custom delivery solutions.
  • Analyze client downstream system requirements to draft comprehensive Functional & Technical Specification files.
  • Navigating complex data mapping requirements.
  • Managing secure connectivity across diverse IT infrastructures.
  • Leading a technical team to deliver bespoke integration solutions in the client‑required format and under tight deadlines.
  • Facilitate daily stand‑ups to track progress, remove blockers, and ensure alignment with the delivery roadmap.
  • Perform Internal QA on custom templates (Excel, CSV, JSON) to ensure 100% accuracy against the signed‑off specifications.
  • Act as the first line of defense for production issues: perform initial triage and investigation of reported bugs.

The Team You’ll Work With

You’ll be joining our Custom Integrations Team, a specialized engineering and delivery pod within the broader R&D and Implementation/delivery teams. Our team is the critical link between our core LPPA engine and the production environments of the world’s leading Limited Partners (LPs). We are a high‑impact, agile unit consisting of a Lead, a Tech Lead, and Developers, dedicated to architecting bespoke data transformation and delivery solutions. By ensuring our data integrates seamlessly into diverse downstream systems, we directly enable our clients to achieve real‑time visibility into their private market investments. Our work is the final, essential step in the value chain, turning raw extracted data into a functional, automated asset for our customers.

About You

  • Technical Liaison. You act as the primary technical point of contact for new clients, translating complex downstream system requirements into comprehensive Functional and Technical Specification files.
  • Integration Architect. You are adept at navigating complex data mapping requirements and are familiar with secure connectivity across diverse IT infrastructures, including APIs, SFTP, SharePoint, and Cloud Storage.
  • Agile Delivery Lead. You are comfortable leading a specialized technical team to deliver bespoke integration solutions in client‑required formats while maintaining alignment with strict delivery roadmaps and deadlines.
  • Operational Driver. You are familiar with tools like Jira and Confluence, using them to govern the full development lifecycle, prioritize backlogs, document technical specs, and facilitate daily stand‑ups to remove blockers.
  • Quality : You take a hands‑on approach to Internal QA, ensuring 100% accuracy against signed‑off specifications before any data is delivered to a stakeholder.
  • First‑Line Responder. You act as the first line of defense for production issues, performing the initial triage and root‑cause investigation of reported bugs before prioritizing engineering tickets.
  • 3+ years of experience recommended in technical implementation, integration engineering, or technical project management.

description:

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting organisationally to the Senior Ticketing Operations Manager the Ticketing Stadium Configuration Manager will help building and maintaining stadium seating maps for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Working in close collaboration with the Configuration and Inventory team in Zurich and other key individuals responsible for the management of ticketing inventory, seating plans and its maintenance in the Ticketing System, ensuring data accuracy throughout the planning phase and during the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the central liaison to FIFA Zurich, facilitating alignment on strategic priorities, reporting, and operational updates
  • Provide hands‑on support and guidance to the local team, ensuring they have the resources, information, and leadership needed to deliver high‑quality operational outcomes
  • Support and build accurate seating plans in the ticketing system for FIFA tournament venues of the host country
  • Manage and oversee the implementation of all necessary seating information and configuration of spectator flows, price categories, seat allocations and carry out required updates
  • Maintain on day‑to‑day basis seating maps and configurations within the ticketing system throughout all stages of FIFA tournaments and apply changes as required
  • Ensure data integrity and accuracy of all seating information and configuration
  • Evaluate outcomes of quality inspections and propose corrective measures
  • Carry out the seat allocation and seat assignment process in the ticketing system
  • Assess and analyse maps and plans of FIFA tournament venues to identify gaps and changes to be applied in the seating plans and configurations
  • Plan, prepare and carry out on‑site seat inspection visits to fully validate seating plans as built in the ticketing system with the actual venue seating
  • Support the overall management of ticketing inventory by conducting quality assurance measures for both ticket quotas and seat allocations
  • Administer allocations and additional ticket requests during the tournaments
  • Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events

YOUR PROFILE

Education / Experience

  • Bachelor degree or similar level of education
  • Experience working with ticketing systems (preferably Secutix)
  • 5 years of professional experience
  • 1–3 years of experience in ticketing or similar functional area (first experiences in creating seating maps or floor plans in a software application of advantage)
  • Experience in data analytics and/ or management
  • Onsite ticketing operations experience
  • Experience in working with CAD technical drawings
  • Native‑level fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English; proficiency in additional languages is valued.

Skills & Competencies

  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Ability to work independently, managing multiple priorities
  • Ability to coordinate across functional areas such as security, broadcasting, hospitality
  • Strong analytical skills, detail‑oriented, technology‑minded, efficient and accountable team player
  • Ability to adapt to working with different environment and time zones

Certifications & Requirements

  • Willingness to travel to host cities.
  • Availability to work extended hours during test events and tournament time.
  • Experience working in international, multicultural environments preferred.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

  • Experiência em rotinas de manutenção de sistemas elétricos em corrente alternada (CA): geração de energia, interpretação de projetos, dimensionamento de demanda e operação de equipamentos como Centro de Medição, Cabine de Alta Tensão, Quadros de Distribuição, GMG, USCA e Inversores;
  • Domínio em sistemas de corrente contínua (CC): operação de FCC, NoBreaks e bancos de baterias, assegurando redundância e continuidade de energia;
  • Experiência em dimensionamento e projeto de sistemas elétricos de potência, proteção e seletividade em Média e Baixa Tensão (CA e CC);
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de proteção contra descargas atmosféricas (SPDA) e avaliação de conformidade;
  • Experiência em operação e dimensionamento de sistemas de climatização (PLC, Split, Self Contained, Fancoil, Chiller), garantindo eficiência térmica em ambientes críticos;
  • Conhecimento em automação predial e protocolos de comunicação (BMS, redes de monitoramento), com capacidade de análise de alarmes e tendências;
  • Aplicação prática das normas técnicas e regulatórias (NR, NBR, ANSI, TIA, ASHRAE), assegurando compliance e segurança operacional;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de visualização e análise de dados (Power BI, Excel avançado - fórmulas, vlookup, tabelas dinâmicas), para relatórios e planos de ação;
  • Experiência em gestão de orçamento, com foco em otimização de custos e eficiência operacional;

title: Software Maintenance Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Software Maintenance Engineer to work in a dynamic and exciting engineering role in Linux‑based infrastructure and applications. You will cover all layers of the stack, including bare metal, virtualization (KVM), containerization (Docker/LXC/LXD), storage (Ceph and Linux file systems), networking (OVS, OVN and Core networking), OpenStack, Kubernetes and the open source applications running on top of them. It will challenge you to show the breadth of your engineering skills, which will be needed to work on almost any aspect of Ubuntu and the open source applications large enterprise customers run.

This role deals with critical issues in the open source stack that require upstream bug fixes. Our engineers are able to work productively at any level of the stack including the kernel and in a wide range of languages, to understand and address the software issues at hand. Our group is critical to the success of our customers, partners and Ubuntu itself. You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.

Location: This is a remote role, we have teams in all time zones.

The role entails

  • Resolve complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software
  • Maintain a close working relationship with Canonical’s Field, Support and product engineering teams
  • Participate in upstream communities
  • Develop bug fixes, backport patches, and work with upstream for inclusion
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrate good judgment in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritize work and manage your time effectively against those priorities
  • Participate in team discussions to improve processes, tools, and documentation
  • Maintain clear, technical and concise communications
  • Work from home and travel internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Experience with Linux and open source software
  • Experience with at least one of Python, Go, C or C++ on Linux
  • A drive to learn unfamiliar technology and deep‑dive difficult issues
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Nice‑to‑have skills

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self‑motivated
  • You have interest in, or willingness to learn about, any of the following: Ubuntu Linux – kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD, PostgreSQL, Mongo, Debian packaging, distributed systems

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Sales Analyst
description:
Overview


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.


Department and Location


Department: Partnerships & Media


Location: Brazil


The Position


The Sales Analyst will support the sponsorship sales team with research, analysis and data on potential sponsors. She/He will be responsible for generating research reports, data sets, market/category/brand specific insights and sales materials as well as the management of the Business Development Directory.


She/He will also be responsible for supporting the sales team in building compelling sales presentations utilising a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies. A key role in supporting sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, with a strong focus on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.


The role requires deep market knowledge, a robust network in the region, and the ability to communicate fluently in English and Portuguese. Spanish is considered a plus.


Key Responsibilities



  • Work closely with the Head of Partnership Sales, FIFA Women’s World Cup Sales Lead and the broader commercial team to deliver on sponsorship sales objectives for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, with a strong emphasis on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.

  • Work closely with the Partnership Sales team to deliver sponsorship and sales objectives, identifying and pursuing high-value sponsorship leads aligned with the commercial strategy of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

  • Support the sales team research function, building compelling sales presentations utiliseing a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies.

  • Conduct in-depth desk and internet research.

  • Produce a range of materials (in collaboration with creative team) to support the sales managers throughout commercial discussions.

  • Become primary liaison with external suppliers and various internal research departments.

  • Support the sales team in sourcing, qualifying, and engaging potential sponsors, supporting generating tailored partnership proposals for major regional and international brands.

  • Ensure timely and accurate update and management of the CRM system for the FWWC27 Commercial team

  • Collaborate with the Strategy and Planning team to identify market opportunities and build compelling sales arguments.

  • Stay informed on emerging sponsorship categories, regional industry trends, and relevant market research, including pricing and inventory benchmarks.

  • Support the organisation of commercial events, conferences, hosting programmes, dedicated to cultivating business relationships and building into the sales pipeline.


Your Profile



  • Highly professional, articulate and results-driven.

  • Proven experience in similar roles within sponsorship sales, business development, or commercial partnerships, preferably in sports or entertainment.

  • Experience using consumer insights platforms (ex. GlobalWebIndex)

  • Exposure to media value reports and how they’re used in sponsorship

  • Familiarity with market research platforms and broader sponsorship market

  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian and LATAM commercial landscape.

  • Ability to work independently in a multi-task position within a dynamic, team-based environment.

  • Solutions orientated.

  • Solid time management and organizational skills.

  • Internal client oriented, efficient and effective.

  • Adept at handling and protecting confidential information.

  • Excellent team player and relationship builder.

  • Attention to detail, reliable and responsible.

  • An appreciation of the international sports federation environment, passion for women’s sports and global events.

  • University degree in business, sports marketing or related area

  • Excellent in Word / PowerPoint / Excel / PDF / MS Teams / Salesforce and other CRM tools

  • Fluent in English and Portuguese, any other FIFA language (Spanish especially) is an advantage

  • Ability to travel often and when required.

  • Right to work in Brazil.

  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Non‑Negotiables

  • Ensure the Core Competencies of the greater organization are embraced.

PROJECTS Key Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Work with the Lead Pre‑Commissioning Engineer to develop Pre‑Commissioning execution methodologies for offshore and onshore projects.
  • Provide key inputs for engineering and planning to be developed.
  • Define and order equipment and installation aids.
  • Specify and identify suitable Pre‑Commissioning spreads and vessels.
  • Prepare Task Plans with support from Lead Pre‑Commissioning Engineer.
  • Review of Subcontractor Pre‑Commissioning procedures.
  • Prepare Readiness review, Constructability, HAZID.
  • Conduct site visits.
  • Prepare Master Equipment List.
  • Procurement of materials and services.
  • Interface with Pre‑Commissioning Subcontractor on deck layouts. Obtain seafastening packages for vessel spreads and interface with installation team.
  • Equipment inventory, preservation and staging for each mobilization.
  • Attend function tests.
  • Mobilize Pre‑Commissioning equipment and vessels to execute work scopes.
  • Arrange the testing and load‑out of Pre‑Commissioning equipment and installation aids.
  • Coordinate the execution of onshore & offshore Pre‑Commissioning work scopes.
  • Coordinate the demobilization of the Pre‑Commissioning equipment, marine spread and the off‑hire of subcontract equipment.
  • Work at site (onshore and offshore) as required by the project.
  • Prepare MOC's with support from Lead Pre‑Commissioning Engineer.
  • Compile and issue Site Memo’s and maintain system completion plan.
  • Compile and present return of experience and lesson learned documents.
  • To train and mentor Field Engineers.
  • Work with the Pre‑Commissioning Technical Authority to align on Pre‑Commissioning execution methodologies.
  • Preparation of subcontractor scopes of works.
  • Manage Pre‑Commissioning subcontracts.
  • Daily Progress Reporting.

TENDERS Key Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Assists the Pre‑Commissioning Technical Authority in preparation of technical and commercial build‑ups following the Tendering work instruction.
  • Liaise with installation team during tender phase to ensure alignment on methodologies.
  • Work with the Lead Pre‑Commissioning Engineer to develop Pre‑Commissioning execution methodologies for offshore and onshore tenders.
  • Engineering and planning for the timely execution of the work scope.
  • Specify and identify suitable Pre‑Commissioning spreads and vessels.
  • Reviewing of internal and external deliverables (specifications, standards, drawings, reports, procedures, risk assessments, scopes of work, subcontracts).
  • Prepare installation aids requirements.
  • Prepare subcontractor/vendor scopes of works and subsequent technical bid clarification.
  • Prepare pre‑commissioning method statements where required.
  • To train and mentor Field Engineers.
  • Attend site visits where applicable.
  • Technical bid clarification.
  • Provide input into Technical Bid Evaluation process.

Interfaces

The Senior Field Engineer will maintain strong interfaces with the various disciplines within the business line. The main interfaces for Pre‑Commissioning are:

  • Marine Operations Engineers
  • Engineering
  • SCM
  • QHSES
  • Environmental Specialists
  • Vessel Operations Managers
  • Marine Construction Manager
  • Tender Manager

Qualifications

Required Experience

  • 7 plus years of experience in the oil and gas industry working for major Contractors.
  • Experience managing a team of more than 2 Engineers.
  • The following experience is required:
    • General experience of all shallow and deepwater water installation operations.
    • Rigid & flexible pipeline Pre‑Commissioning experience - execution of a minimum of 8 projects.
    • Umbilical pre‑commissioning experience - execution of a minimum of 4 projects.

At Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda, you will become part of a forward‑thinking and inclusive team dedicated to safe and sustainable offshore operations. Our collaborative culture encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, enabling you to make a tangible impact in a challenging and rewarding environment.

If you are a focused, detail‑oriented professional with a strong commitment to equipment integrity and operational safety, and you thrive in a team‑oriented setting, this role offers an excellent platform to advance your career in offshore production.

description:
Somos um grupo que tem como missão democratizar o acesso à saúde privada e ser referência em solução de saúde ambulatorial no Rio de Janeiro.

Buscamos um profissional que possa garantir assistência médica segura e eficaz por meio da execução de procedimentos clínicos e cirúrgicos, contribuindo para a recuperação e bem-estar dos pacientes.

  • Trabalho presencial: Tijuca
  • Horário: de segunda a sexta, de 9h12 às 19h.
  • Remuneração: Salário + benefícios

Atividades

SPA

  • Realizar medição de sinais vitais (pressão arterial, temperatura, frequência cardíaca, respiratória, saturação de oxigênio), conforme prescrição médica ou protocolo da instituição, para avaliar o estado de saúde do paciente e detectar alterações precoces.
  • Fazer e trocar curativos simples conforme a necessidade ou prescrição médica, para promover a cicatrização e prevenir infecções.
  • Administrar medicamentos (oral, intramuscular, intravenoso, subcutâneo), conforme prescrição médica, para tratar, controlar ou prevenir doenças e promover a recuperação do paciente.
  • Auxiliar na parte burocrática do atendimento ajudando com a documentação para agilizar o processo de atendimento.
  • Coletar sangue e urina, conforme prescrição médica, para fornecer dados laboratoriais que auxiliam no diagnóstico, monitoramento e tratamento do paciente.
  • Auxiliar médicos e enfermeiros em procedimentos (suturas, punções, intubações), conforme necessidade ou emergência, para garantir a segurança e eficiência dos procedimentos médicos.
  • Realizar eletrocardiograma (ECG), conforme prescrição médica, para detectar e monitorar condições cardíacas como arritmias e infartos.

Centro Cirúrgico

  • Exercer funções de circulante auxiliando o cirugião e equipe cirúrgica na montagem de sala e administrando os materiais da cirurgia.
  • Dar suporte ao Enfermeiro na triagem, preparando e orientando os pacientes.
  • Recepcionar o paciente, preparar e dilatar pupilas para cirurgia oftalmológica, conforme prescrição médica, utilizando colírios, para preparar o paciente para o procedimento cirúrgico.
  • Controlar e solicitar rouparia, materiais e medicamentos utilizados na área.
  • Fazer a lavagem e preparação do material de cirgurgia.

Endoscopia

  • Auxiliar a equipe médica na realização dos exames.
  • Fazer a desinfecção e controle dos aparelhos utilizados nos exames.
  • Preparar o paciente e realizar montagem da sala para os exames.

Ambulatório

  • Organizar e dar suporte para os médicos de procedimentos em consultório.
  • Organizar e repor estoque de materiais, medicamentos e aparelhos necessários para os atendimentos.
  • Organizar agendas médicas, diariamente, para garantir a organização das consultas e procedimentos médicos.

title: Sr. Director of Pre-Award
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Senior Director of Pre-Award (Outgoing Team) leads the university’s pre-award research administration function, ensuring efficient, compliant, and service-oriented proposal development and submission. The role is responsible for managing all outgoing proposals, outgoing subawards, and consultant agreements, providing direct support to faculty and research administrators while maintaining consistent quality, compliance, and operational standards across the outgoing pre-award lifecycle. As a key leader in the Sponsored Programs Office (SPO), this position provides supervisory oversight of pre-award staff, works closely with institutional leadership, and aligns pre-award services with federal, sponsor, and institutional requirements.

Supervisory Authority

  • Directly supervises Pre-Award Research Administrators and administrative support staff, including setting priorities, managing workloads, and ensuring consistent application of standards across the team.
  • Provides oversight of outgoing proposals, subawards, and consultant agreements within the Sponsored Programs Office.
  • Provides training, mentorship, and professional development to pre-award staff to ensure continuous improvement in research administration, including coaching on performance expectations and process adherence.
  • Oversees faculty engagement and training efforts, ensuring faculty and research administrators receive guidance on proposal development and compliance.
  • Collaborates with the Senior Director of Pre-Award – Incoming team to establish best practices and ensure seamless pre-award operations.

Nature And Scope

  • Reports directly to the Assistant Vice President (AVP) of Sponsored Programs and works in close collaboration with the Senior Director of Pre-Award (Incoming team) to align pre-award strategy with the university’s research mission.
  • Serves as the primary point of contact for faculty and research centers on proposal development and submission.
  • Leads the university’s outgoing proposal and outgoing subaward administration, ensuring that all submissions meet sponsor, federal, and institutional requirements.
  • Engages with Post-Award teams, Research Compliance, and Legal to support seamless research administration processes.

title: Geosupport Lead
description:
Overview

Welcome to PXGEO PXGEO is an innovative marine geophysical service provider combining the strengths of ocean bottom and towed streamer seismic data acquisition techniques to deliver seamless subsurface imaging for a sustainable future.

Role Official company title is Technical Lead - Geophysics. We are seeking an experienced Geophysicist to provide technical geophysical support across the Company's Sales & Marketing, Operations, and Engineering Development teams. This role plays a critical part in ensuring exceptional data quality throughout the full project lifecycle and will be responsible for data quality assurance from the initial receipt of tenders through to the delivery of final survey products to the Client. This position requires close collaboration with internal departments to ensure surveys meet technical, commercial, and client expectations.

Key responsibilities

  • Support for Sales
    • Provide alternative and/or additional survey designs or layouts to more efficiently meet clients\' geophysical objectives
    • Review incoming data acquisition tender requests and provide technical responses, including technical exceptions, survey area maps, shooting plan scenarios and source modelling
    • Complete project time and motion estimations where required
  • Support for Marketing
    • Contribute to the technical standing of the company through publications at industry conferences and in industry journals
    • Assist in the development of the company Geophysical Initiatives
    • Attend Client Meetings as required. As an expert, participate in meetings and contribute actively to development of client relations and participate in the promotion of the company\'s image of excellence
    • Compile and present geophysical and technical slides, and present Company geophysical initiatives
  • Support for Operations
    • Prepare project start-up documentation including preplots, shooting plans, operational maps, and parameter sheets as appropriate for the seismic method
    • Attend seismic project kick-off, start-up and close-out meetings if required to represent Geophysical Services and Technology group
    • Review end of job report for accuracy and quality
    • Problem dataset analysis with appropriate reporting
    • Assist in the design, writing and implementation of procedures, methods and technical content that facilitate good survey practices and the safe and effective operations of the Geophysical Department. Contribute to continual improvement and review of working practices and standards
    • Propose and implement best practices, new technologies and methodologies in QC processing offshore and geophysical support onshore
    • Ensure the geophysical quality of projects by assisting offshore QC Geophysicists to optimize sequences and parameters, contribute to the test and QC plan adapted to the project
    • Monitor Geophysical-related downtime and inform Management of potential means to reduce downtime
    • Review detailed analysis and provide recommendations on a weekly basis for ongoing projects. Recommendations should contain the following:
      • Acquired data quality Vessel performance
      • Coverage and Infill
    • Monitor the health of the deployed receiver spread
    • Provide support for and where necessary supervision of any production processing efforts for the project whether carried out onboard or by the third party onshore
  • Support for Engineering Development
    • Provide geophysical input into the research and development portfolio
    • In cooperation with Engineering Development, conduct technical studies and tests in order to validate new technologies and methodologies
    • Assist in planning, execution and analysis of acquisition technology tests
    • Develop and design source and receiver configurations
  • General
    • Keep abreast of changes in seismic data acquisition and processing technology
    • Administration of the Company seismic project documentation sharing portal and maintain all ITT & Project location history
    • Ensure department\'s assets are tracked and maintained according to Company procedures and best practices
    • Maintain the necessary software toolbox

Qualifications

  • Bachelor\'s degree in Geophysics, Geoscience, Physics, or a related discipline
  • At least 5+ years of extensive experience in geophysical operations including seismic acquisition and QC, within onshore and offshore environments
  • Exposure to marine seismic survey methods and technologies relating to all aspects of seismic surveys with a focus on geophysical method, and processing
  • In-depth knowledge of modern geophysical acquisition technologies and a solid understanding of emerging processing methods and their impact on acquisition design
  • Experience managing geophysical service providers and key technical suppliers
  • Solid understanding of EHSQ principles, compliance with management systems, and delivery of high-quality services
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to act as the primary technical interface for Operations

  • Conhecimento em elaboração de layout de mapas e organização de dados geográficos;
  • Conhecimento básico em ArcGIS Online e Survey 123;
  • Familiaridade com ArcGIS Pro, incluindo ModelBuilder;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com orientação técnica, demonstrando interesse em aprendizado contínuo.

  • Experiência prévia em análises espaciais em projetos ambientais;
  • Conhecimentos introdutórios em Inteligência Artificial ou Machine Learning aplicados ao geoprocessamento;
  • Conhecimento de GPS e manipulação de dados GNSS (GPSTrackMaker, Global Mapper);
  • Conhecimento em Excel;
  • Conhecimento de normas e padrões cartográficos.

title: CFD Engineer, Sustainability
description:
Overview

Job Description The Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) engineer belongs to the Global Sustainability Team focusing on ship energy and operational efficiency. As a Sustainability team engineer, you will contribute to the activities of the Global Sustainability team related to GHG emissions from marine and offshore vessels/assets as well as activities associated with other sustainability-related projects. The CFD engineer is expected to interact with multiple parts of the organization, taking a lead role in driving the ABS Global Sustainability Advisory CFD services related to the hydrodynamic and aerodynamic performance of a vessel. The role requires involvement in international projects and supporting clients to improve the overall environmental performance of their vessels. Our Risk Management team in Brazil supports clients in improving the safety, reliability, and resilience of their assets and operations. We work across CAPEX and OPEX projects, supporting customers in upstream, midstream, downstream, and emerging sectors such as BESS, CCS, and hydrogen.

What You Will Do

  • Execute CFD services to marine clients related to hull and propeller modification, hydrodynamic and aerodynamic energy efficiency technologies, trim optimization, and performance.
  • Contribute to studies that influence important engineering and operational decisions, while also helping shape the next generation of technical capability within the team.
  • Lead or support a variety of technical safety and risk studies, including: Fire and explosion modelling, Flame detector allocation, Exhaust and ventilation dispersion, Smoke and gas dispersion, Flare radiation analysis, Helideck turbulence studies and Process safety and risk studies such as HAZOP, HAZID, LOPA, Bow-Tie, Safety Case, and EERA.
  • Be a focal point of contact for CFD-related services in ABS Global Sustainability: Interact with clients to identify/resolve problems in technical expertise.
  • Maintain and improve ABS numerical calculation tools concerning the CFD services.
  • Manage client projects related to CFD: Take the lead in projects related to vessel performance CFD services.
  • Communicate the status of the current workload to all appropriate team members to ensure client needs are met.
  • Develop numerical analysis-based services and products.
  • Contribute to the development of tools and services for ABS Global Sustainability.
  • Initiate and participate in joint development/industry projects with clients or OEMs.
  • Attend industry events and conferences and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends.
  • Develop a thorough understanding of national and international regulatory developments with environmental protection and update the Global Sustainability team accordingly. May contribute to authoring ABS publications and thought leadership documents.
  • Conduct seminars and workshops as requested.
  • Stay updated on emerging regulatory framework related to GHG emissions.
  • Support the associated service delivery across all geographic locations of Sustainability (Houston, Athens, Copenhagen, Singapore).
  • Maintain awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate.
  • Identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales.
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company’s CRM.
  • Work as a team member or autonomously, as required.
  • Manage or support project execution, schedules, quality, and technical delivery.
  • Interact directly with clients to discuss technical issues, project progress, and solutions.
  • Support proposal development and technical presentations.
  • Mentor and guide junior consultants, collaborating with teams in Brazil and other offices globally.

Requirements

What You Will Need

  • Degree in Engineering, preferably Chemical or Mechanical Engineering
  • At least 6 years of relevant experience
  • Strong experience in advanced CFD modelling applied to risk and safety
  • Experience in analyses related to fire, explosion, dispersion, and detection studies
  • Fluent Portuguese and English
  • Strong report writing, communication, and presentation skills
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and deliver high-quality technical work in a consulting environment

Education and Experience Desired

  • M.Sc. or postgraduate qualification in Safety Engineering, Process Safety, or related field
  • Experience in QRA, vulnerability analysis, PHAST, and/or SAFETI
  • Knowledge of Human Factors, including: Human Reliability Analysis (HRA), Human Factors Engineering (HFE)
  • Familiarity with Petro-HRA
  • Familiarity with Brazilian regulations and industry requirements, including Petrobras guidelines, ANP requirements, and applicable NRs
  • Experience across upstream, downstream, and midstream
  • Knowledge of Python, VBA, or other programming/automation tools
  • Interest in digitalization and technical innovation
  • Spanish language skills

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Track record in applying CFD and data analysis software tools to deliver technical solutions to clients.
  • FLACS
  • KFX
  • Ansys Fluent
  • Ansys CFX
  • Hydrodynamics and naval architecture knowledge; aerodynamics is a plus
  • Working knowledge of Linux and CAD packages (e.g., Rhino 3D)
  • Knowledge of additional software: OpenFoam, StarCCM+, Paraview
  • Proficiency with scripting and coding languages for pre-processing, post-processing, and data analytics (Python or other)
  • Ability to solve complex problems and work independently or in a team
  • Ability to manage project requirements, budgets, schedules, and technical work
  • Experience with marine or offshore applications
  • Experience with programming and advanced MS Office use
  • Client presentation capability
  • Excellent communication skills (oral and written)
  • Commitment to ethical business practices per corporate policies
  • Proficiency in English
  • Ability to develop working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, regulations, and safety policy

Reporting Relationships

Reporting directly to the operations manager.

About Us

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and related safety, quality, and environmental services. We support organizations facing evolving regulations and technologies, with a focus on safety, reliability, and efficiency. We are committed to supporting the global energy transition at sea and related innovations.

Equal Opportunity

The ABS Group of Companies is committed to equal employment opportunity and prohibits discrimination based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status, veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics protected by law.

Notice

ABS will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement signed by Human Resources. Any resume or submission provided without a valid MSA will be considered ABS property.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Assistant Director – Military and Veterans Services (ADMVS) directs, plans, and organizes all veterans’ services initiatives. The ADMVS assists with and helps lead the department's vision, goals, and objectives for the department. The ADMVS reports to the Director of Student Services.

Nature And Scope

The primary function of the ADMVS is to assume responsibility for most activities, procedures, and policies related to the Howard University Military connected community, including assisting with the department’s budget and staff. This position provides strategic direction for the assigned department under the general guidance of the Director of Student Services.

The position is responsible for implementing the policies and procedures to assist the Howard University Military & Veterans Community. The ADMVS performs the administrative and technical duties required to establish and maintain a program to assist Military connected individuals in obtaining educational, financial, social services and other benefits available through the Federal, State and local legislation. This position requires evening and weekend hours and accessibility as student needs arise.

Supervisory Accountability

Direct supervision of two Veterans Affairs Coordinators (Certifying School Officials). Supervision of one Veteran Resource Coordinator.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serve as point of contact for veteran's educational programs, policies, procedures and regulations
  • Serve as liaison between HU and the VA for eligibility for veteran students
  • Develop and expand the University's relationships with other U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs and other services agencies
  • Provide accurate information to all interested parties regarding current educational benefits and programs which are provided by federal and state government and local agencies to support veterans
  • Counsel students and parents concerning eligibility and benefits available under various programs
  • Ensure compliance with federal and state government reporting requirements related to veterans’ educational benefits
  • Manage and monitor schedule changes, major changes, withdrawals, audits and inapplicable courses for appropriate changes in benefits
  • Implement control measures to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of certification
  • Establish and maintain student VA files
  • Coordinate with the office of Admission and Recruiting, Records and Registration, Financial Aid, and Disabilities Services to improve the enrollment process for military connected students
  • Recommend, implement, and administer methods and procedures to enhance recruitment efforts
  • Develop a working knowledge of ASU academic programs that are of interest to veterans’ students
  • Evaluate U.S. Armed Forces transcripts for transfer credit and transfer equivalencies
  • Develop and maintain the department's website
  • Represent the University on committees and advisory groups that work to advance and enhance VA benefits, and state and regional organizations that assist veteran students with four-year college graduation
  • Actively promote programs that engage veterans and the campus community
  • Perform other duties as assigned by Senior Leaders within The Office of Student Services and Student Affairs

Collaboration and Partnership

  • Partner with the Howard University Bursar’s office for seamless and streamlined communication
  • Collaborate and coordinate with the financial aid office
  • Provide recommendations, tools and resources for faculty and staff to assist them in how to support military connected students
  • Develop, cultivate, and sustain collaborative and effective working relationships with key stakeholders outside the Division of Student Affairs

Core Competencies

  • Strong interpersonal, analytical, critical thinking, professional judgment, oral and written communication
  • Demonstrated ability to work with a diverse and inclusive student population
  • Self-directed; self-motivated individual who can work autonomously with minimal supervision while managing multiple situations
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize, follow through, meet deadlines, and make professional decisions
  • Ability to work independently, collaboratively across multiple offices and in a team environment
  • Flexibility and accessibility particularly as it relates to responding to and attending to student needs
  • Demonstrated work ethic that illustrates integrity, ethics, sound professional judgment and an appreciation for diversity, equity, and inclusion
  • Competent and comfortable with technology and ability to utilize data to inform decisions
  • Strong writing, editing, and presentation skills
  • Ability to handle sensitive matters with exceptionally good judgment and discretion
  • Experience supervising employees, including hiring and evaluation

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in education, training, and experience
  • 3-5 years of experience with student support initiatives in higher education or a similar setting
  • Previous Military Services

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree in Counseling, Public Health, Education, Higher Education, Student Affairs, Social Work, or a related field
  • 5-7 years related experience
  • Ability to build knowledge base of national trends and best practices

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $75,000 - $85,000

description:
Job Description

M3 Global Research, an M3 company, is seeking a Senior Data Engineer with SQL DBA expertise to join our data engineering team. This role will primarily focus on database administration (DBA) tasks such as optimization, performance tuning, and security.

The ideal candidate will have strong SQL database administration expertise. They will be responsible for understanding business needs, prioritizing work, leading daily standups, and effectively communicating technical solutions to stakeholders. While direct Power BI development is not required, the candidate should be able to guide and support the team’s work and ensure alignment with business objectives.

Primary DBA Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle) for performance, security, and availability.
  • Design and maintain database schemas, indexes, and partitions to support scalability and efficiency.
  • Perform database monitoring, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Implement security best practices, including access control, encryption, and auditing.
  • Troubleshoot database performance issues and optimize query performance.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance, security policies, and industry standards.

Team Responsibilities

  • Participate in daily standups, prioritize tasks, and ensure alignment with business needs.
  • Translate business requirements into actionable data engineering tasks.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that Power BI and data solutions meet business objectives.
  • Mentor team members and drive best practices in data management and reporting.

Qualifications

  • Strong SQL database administration expertise (performance tuning, security, backup/recovery).
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills to work with both technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage a team’s workload while driving business objectives.
  • Problem‑solving mindset with a strong attention to detail.

AI and Automation Expectations

  • Strong hands‑on experience with modern AI models and developer tooling to improve software delivery speed and quality.
  • Ability to use AI effectively for SQL performance tuning, database reliability validation, migration planning, and operational runbook automation.
  • Experience applying AI to testing workflows, including test scenario generation, regression coverage expansion, and edge‑case identification.
  • Proven ability to create practical automation that reduces manual effort while maintaining quality, security, and auditability.
  • Comfortable evaluating AI output quality, selecting the right model/tool for the task, and using secure patterns for sensitive data.
  • Track record of measurable efficiency gains (faster cycle times, improved stability, reduced operational toil, or better delivery predictability).

Engagement Model

  • This role will begin as a contract engagement with a planned path to full‑time conversion based on performance, impact, and organizational need.
  • We are looking for someone who can deliver quickly in a hands‑on environment and grow into long‑term technical leadership.

Additional Information

  • We are currently targeting candidates located in Brazil who are willing to work US EST hours.
  • We kindly ask that you submit your resume in English.
  • M3 reserves the right to change this job description to meet the business needs of the organization.

title: MEDICO PNEUMOLOGISTA DIARISTA- HOSPITAL CARDOSO FONTES
description:
Overview

Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes. O Hospital Cardoso Fontes é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar atividades da especialidade de pneumologia, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal da Saúde.

  • Realizar consulta e atendimento médico, anamnese, exame físico, propedêutica instrumental;
  • Interpretar dados de exame clínico e exames complementares e diagnosticar estado de saúde;
  • Discutir diagnóstico, prognóstico, tratamento e prevenção com usuários, responsáveis e familiares;
  • Planejar e prescrever tratamento e praticar intervenções clínicas e cirúrgicas quando couber;
  • Prescrever medicamentos, hemoderivados e cuidados especiais;
  • Implementar ações para promoção da saúde, elaborar e avaliar prontuários, emitir receitas;
  • Participar de equipes interdisciplinares e multiprofissionais, realizando atividades em conjunto, tais como: discussão de casos, reuniões administrativas, matriciamento, entre outras;
  • Participar, conforme a política interna da Secretaria Municipal da Saúde (SMS), de projetos, cursos, eventos, comissões, convênios e programas de ensino, pesquisa e extensão;
  • Elaborar relatórios e laudos técnicos em sua área de especialidade;
  • Participar de programa de treinamento, quando convocado;
  • Trabalhar segundo normas técnicas de segurança, qualidade, produtividade, higiene e preservação ambiental;
  • Executar tarefas pertinentes à área de atuação, utilizando-se de equipamentos e programas de informática;
  • Estar em consonância com as diretrizes de práticas médicas baseadas em evidências publicadas;
  • Preencher adequadamente e de forma legível todos os formulários padronizados pelo serviço manualmente ou de forma digital;
  • Registrar Estatística Internacional de Doenças (CID) e justificativas nos Serviços de Apoio Diagnóstico Terapêutico (SADT) e guias de referência;
  • Sinalizar prioridade de encaminhamento nas solicitações (alta, média ou baixa);
  • Realizar a contra referência do paciente à Unidade Básica de Saúde de sua referência após a alta ambulatorial ou durante o acompanhamento dos casos crônicos que permanecerem por mais tempo em acompanhamento no serviço conforme Código de Ética Médica;
  • Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM;
  • Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais - LGPD;
  • Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.

Requisitos e qualificações

Graduação em Medicina com diploma reconhecido pelo MEC.

Residência médica em Pediatria em pneumologista

Experiência de 6 meses na função.

Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.

Informações adicionais

Local: Jacarepaguá/RJ

Escala: 20h semanais

Horário: a combinar

Overview

SOBRE A CAPCO A CAPCO é uma consultoria global de tecnologia e negócios, focada no setor de serviços financeiros e energia. Se você mora na Região de Macaé , essa vaga é para você!

Responsibilities

  • Prestar suporte na elaboração e revisão dos documentos de medição contratual e registros operacionais.
  • Interagir com fiscais para acompanhar análise do desempenho operacional das operações.
  • Participar e apoiar a realização de Minutas de cartas externas e/ou documentos internos de controles e durações operacionais.
  • Calcular os indicadores de Desempenho da gerência relacionados às Embarcações e realizar análise crítica das operações finalizadas, bem como o acumulado no ano, inserindo comentários no local definido. Realizar estudos de projeção/simulações dos indicadores de Desempenho da gerência.
  • Realizar conferência e ajuste de Painéis em BI, quando necessário. Participar de reuniões de passagem de serviço entre Planejamento e Operação.
  • Realizar análise crítica dos documentos recebidos do Planejamento (ex.: APRs, MDs, APOs e SOPs) para retornar sobre a qualidade, propor melhorias e otimizações. Acompanhar o desenrolar das operações com embarcações, mantendo-se informado sobre embarque de materiais, situação técnica de equipamentos e ferramentas, interface com outros setores, entre outros. Realizar validação/aprovação de documentos gerados durante a operação, com base nas melhores práticas operacionais, de segurança e nos procedimentos (exemplos: Relatórios de Anomalia, Verificações de Qualidade de Procedimento, Gestões de Mudança, Sugestões de Melhoria).
  • Trabalhar de forma proativa para conhecer as informações técnicas das ferramentas e equipamentos envolvidos nas operações, participando de discussões técnicas com outros setores. Compreender a rotina da gerência operacional e os sistemas informatizados utilizados.
  • Conhecer os procedimentos que afetem diretamente sua atividade, especialmente aqueles sob a gestão da gerência setorial em que estiver prestando serviço.
  • Participar, dar suporte técnico e soluções de engenharia nas contingências operacionais, considerando as melhores práticas operacionais e de segurança.
  • Ao final das operações, realizar análise de desempenho para identificar pontos positivos a replicar e pontos negativos, criando ações para evitar reincidência, divulgando lições aprendidas em reuniões ou fóruns.
  • Apoiar outras gerências, quando solicitado, para fornecer suporte técnico nas fases de projeto, planejamento e operação.
  • Conduzir reuniões designadas e se informar proativamente sobre a condução, postura e registro em ata.
  • Dar suporte na gestão e atendimento dos padrões relacionados às atividades em Embarcações, revisando ou emitindo-os quando necessário.
  • Diligenciar, emitir e/ou executar ações de Gestão de Mudanças, conforme padrões aplicáveis.
  • Participar de RACs (Reuniões de Análise Críticas) relacionadas às Embarcações e consolidar o material para RACs com foco em Desempenho.
  • Coordenar e/ou participar da APR (Análise Preliminar de Risco) das operações em Embarcações, conforme padrões aplicáveis.
  • Coordenar e/ou participar do tratamento de anomalias em Embarcações, emitindo Relatório de Tratamento de Anomalia com plano de ação, causas básicas, ações de bloqueio e abrangência. Realizar o preenchimento de documentações para órgãos reguladores como ANP e IBAMA (p. ex., Relatório Detalhado de Incidente - RDI e Relatório de Atendimento a Incidente de Poluição por Óleo - RAIPO).

Capacitação e Qualificações

  • Graduação de nível superior concluída em Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia Mechatrônica, Engenharia Metalúrgica ou Engenharia de Materiais.
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos, relacionada a atividades com equipamentos submarinos em barcos da área submarina (PLSVs, RSVs, SESV etc.).
  • Registro no Conselho de Classe (CREA).
  • Inglês intermediário.
  • Observação: outras formações em Engenharia são aceitas, desde que acompanhadas de certidão emitida pelo respectivo Conselho de Classe atestando a posse de todas as atribuições profissionais das Engenharias citadas.

Conhecimentos Específicos

  • Domínio pleno de ferramenta de planilha eletrônica (pacote Microsoft Office – incluindo Power BI e SharePoint) com habilidade para geração de painéis dinâmicos e sites.
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de análise de riscos, tais como HAZOP, APR, FMEA/FMECA e Diagramas Bow-Tie. Capacidade de coordenar a elaboração de uma APR.
  • Gerenciamento de Mudança (MOC, Management of Change).
  • Conhecimento de normas e regulamentos pertinentes a equipamentos submarinos, tais como API 6A / ISO 10423, API 17D / ISO 13628-4, API 17G / ISO 13628-7, ISO 13628-8, ISO 19901-6, ABNT NR 11, DNVGL-RP-N103, DNVGL-ST-N001, SGSS e SGIP, entre outros.
  • Domínio do SAP: módulos de materiais (MM) e de manutenção (PM).

Na Capco promovemos uma cultura inclusiva. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas expressões.

Pensamos, em conjunto, sempre em ações diversas de inclusão e de responsabilidade social através de comitês internos geridos pela nossa comunidade interna, como os grupos de Mulheres, Pessoas Com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras, LGBTQIAPN+, Parentalidade, Gerações, entre outros.

description:
Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Gerenciar o Sistema de Gestão de SST Axia, garantindo conformidade legal e melhoria contínua (PDCA).
  • Conduzir análises de risco em atividades de Sistema Elétrico de Potência (SEP): APR/JSA, Matriz de Riscos, LOTO e Liberação de PT (Permissão de Trabalho) para intervenção em linhas de transmissão (LT), subestações (SE) e usinas hidrelétricas (UHE).
  • Responder tecnicamente pela segurança de atividades críticas: trabalhos em altura (NR 35), espaços confinados (NR 33), energia elétrica (NR 10 – Básico e SEP), máquinas e equipamentos (NR 12), movimentação de cargas (NR 11/NR 18 quando aplicável), escavações (NR 18), e frentes remotas/obras lineares.
  • Planejar e auditar o GRO/PGR (Gerenciamento de Riscos Ocupacionais / Programa de Gerenciamento de Riscos), inventário de riscos, plano de ação, procedimentos operacionais e planos de resposta a emergências (incl. simulações em SE/UHE e integração com Brigada).
  • Investigar incidentes e acidentes (com e sem afastamento) com metodologia estruturada, emitir relatórios, ART quando aplicável, e garantir implementação/eficácia das ações corretivas.
  • Aprovar e acompanhar obras, montagens eletromecânicas, comissionamentos e manutenções programadas/emergenciais, incluindo análise de riscos de pátios de manobra, casas de força, vertedouros e barragens, e gestão de interfaces com O&M.
  • Gestão de contratadas: qualificação (prérequisitos de SST), auditorias de campo e de documentação (ASOs, treinamentos legais, certificações), verificação de EPC/EPI e desempenho de indicadores (TRIFR, LTIFR, taxa de gravidade, near miss).
  • Gestão de mudanças (MoC) em projetos e operações (mudanças de tecnologia, método, pessoal, instalações), incluindo APR de mudança e revalidação de procedimentos.
  • Conduzir programas de cultura de segurança: diálogos diários (DDS), campanhas, treinamentos e Paradas/Diálogos de Segurança; atuar como referência técnica para liderança, CIPA e SESMT.
  • Gestão documental: prontuários, PPRA/PGR histórico, PCMSO (com Médico do Trabalho), registros de inspeções (checklists LT/SE/UHE), prontuário de NR 10, prontuário de máquinas/NR 12, certificados, laudos, ART e relatórios executivos para diretoria.
  • Apoiar avaliações de riscos de empreendimentos (greenfield/brownfield) e definição de requisitos de segurança no engenharia de projeto (HSE by design).
  • Disponibilidade para campo e viagens em corredores de LT, canteiros, SEs e UHEs; atuação em múltiplos sites e em cenários de contingência (plantões/eventos críticos).

Requisitos e Qualificações

Habilidades e Conhecimentos

  • Legislação e Normas: NRs (especialmente NR 1 – GRO/PGR, NR 6, NR 10 (Básico e SEP), NR 12, NR 18, NR 33, NR 35), ABNT NBR aplicáveis ao setor elétrico, ISO 45001, ISO 14001, boas práticas de OHS/EHS.

Integrity Engineer

Summary

Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda is seeking a dedicated Integrity Engineer. This important role supports the onshore operations with a key focus on maintaining and assuring the integrity and safe operation of FPSO units and associated equipment. As an Integrity Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company’s interests by ensuring that all inspection, testing, and maintenance activities on critical equipment are carried out with high standards of safety, compliance, and efficiency. You will be integral to a team committed to operational excellence and proactive risk management within the offshore oil and gas sector.

  • Organise and oversee the activities related to NR 13 / SPIE compliance in collaboration with equipment inspectors from FPSO units, including maintaining comprehensive and up-to-date documentation such as official books, calibration certificates, inspection reports, and audit records.
  • Manage internal and external inspection schedules, ensuring adherence to regulatory and company standards, while maintaining close coordination with operation managers to integrate inspection activities within shutdown plans effectively.
  • Lead the evaluation and implementation of training programs for Equipment Inspectors, Operators, and Technicians to uphold competency and safety standards across all levels of operations.
  • Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details.

  • Ensure rigorous verification and performance testing of safety valves and other safety‑critical equipment, either by performing, witnessing, or overseeing such tests to guarantee reliable operation.
  • Conduct audits of equipment manufacturers as required, supporting thorough supplier qualification and quality assurance.
  • Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (Yinson teams) and external parties (clients, contractors) to foster transparent communication and alignment on objectives and compliance requirements.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by management in support of the company’s goals and regulatory compliance.

Key Competencies

  • Commercial Awareness: Understand the wider business context and how operational integrity relates to company performance and risk management.
  • Safeguarding Company Interest: Demonstrate commitment to protecting company assets, reputation, and operational continuity.
  • Cost Control Experience: Apply cost control principles within offshore oil and gas projects to optimise expenditure without compromising safety or quality.
  • Teamwork: Work collaboratively across multi-disciplinary teams and with external partners, fostering a positive and productive working environment.
  • Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions.
  • Analytical and Problem‑Solving Abilities: Use strong analytical skills to assess equipment conditions, interpret inspection data, and develop practical solutions.
  • Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy in documentation, procedures, and reporting to support compliance and operational excellence.
  • Responsibility and Proactivity: Take ownership of tasks, demonstrate initiative, and work in a hands‑on manner to achieve targets and resolve issues promptly.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Engineering degree is mandatory.
  • CREA‑RJ accreditation is required.
  • Post‑Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considered a strong advantage.
  • Experience as an Operations Engineer within the Brazilian oil and gas sector, with experience specifically in integrity engineering preferred.
  • Proven experience working with FPSO projects and offshore operations is highly desirable.
  • Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders.

Why Join Us?

At Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda, you will become part of a forward‑thinking and inclusive team dedicated to safe and sustainable offshore operations. We value initiative and provide opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic sector. Our collaborative culture encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, enabling you to make a tangible impact in a challenging and rewarding environment.

If you are a focused, detail‑oriented professional with a strong commitment to equipment integrity and operational safety, and you thrive in a team‑oriented setting, this role offers an excellent platform to advance your career in offshore production.
