title: Especialista em Operações Comerciais
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR) .

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM!

description:
Location: Rio de Janeiro, RJ, BR

Work Arrangement: Hybrid

At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths.

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Human Resources LATAM serves as a strategic and tactical business partner to the LATAM team, driving the execution of HR strategies for the region. Reporting to the Director, Human Resources EMEA & SAL and based out of our factory in Rio de Janeiro, this role oversees all aspects of HR—including talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, learning and development, talent management, employee relations, policy design, and HR operations.

Operating as a primary business partner for the Rio manufacturing site and the wider regional business, the Senior Manager fosters a high-performance, employee-centric culture. This role emphasizes quality, productivity, and empowerment while ensuring all HR initiatives are aligned with global, regional, and local strategies to drive business success.

Key Responsibilities

Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Strategic HR Leadership & Business Partnership
    • Provide HR leadership and functional support across multiple departments, including Operations, Sourcing, Sales, Customer Service, and Legal.
    • Ensure HR strategies are effectively aligned with business priorities, fostering an adaptable and high-performing workforce.
    • Provide expert consultation to managers and senior leaders on HR-related matters.
    • Collaborate across departments to ensure a seamless employee experience and a strong people strategy.
  • Partner with leadership and regional Talent Development to counsel on employee impact decisions, supporting workforce planning, succession, and development initiatives.
  • Lead efforts to enhance talent mobility and strengthen leadership capabilities within the organization.
  • Manage talent engagement processes, including recruitment, compensation, promotions, training, and performance management, in partnership with the local HR team.
  • Support global mobility for key employees, collaborating with global mobility teams and HR peers.
  • Employee Engagement and culture
    • Cultivate a high-performance, inclusive work environment that aligns with Dover values and DFS’ company culture.
    • Support initiatives that enhance employee engagement, workplace satisfaction, and long-term retention.
  • Consult with business leaders to drive organizational design, change management, and leadership development strategies.
  • Diagnose workforce gaps and design solutions for regional and local implementation.
  • Oversee succession planning processes, fostering leadership development and career progression for key talent.
  • HR Operations, compliance & leadership
    • Manage, guide, and mentor HR team members based in Rio de Janeiro.
    • Ensure compliance with local labor laws and global HR requirements.
    • Develop and implement HR policies and procedures, ensuring alignment with corporate guidelines.
    • Monitor and manage key HR metrics, providing data-driven insights for business decisions.

Candidate Experience and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will bring strategic HR leadership at both local and regional levels, with experience in fast-paced, evolving business environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources management or business administration.
  • Experience in partnering with senior leadership teams.
  • Experience in multiple locations.
  • Fluent Portuguese and English language skills, both verbal and written, Spanish is a preference.
  • Exceptional critical thinking skills: ability to decompose complex problems, prioritize issues, and implement sensible solutions.
  • Track record of creating strong partnerships and influencing at all levels of the organization.
  • Superior interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to increase productivity and continuously improve methods, approaches.
  • Experience in organizational development and change management.
  • Proven ability to work in a fluid, fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality.

title: Patient Care Coordinator
description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

This URL is for benefits and wellness: Function

The Patient Care Coordinator provides frontline administrative and clinical support to HIV primary care services, with a specialized focus on coordinating long-acting injectable HIV therapies. This role ensures seamless scheduling, medication tracking, patient engagement, and operational support to promote continuity of care and optimize viral suppression outcomes. The ideal candidate is highly organized, patient-centered, and experienced in clinical coordination within a fast-paced healthcare setting.

Supervisory Accountability

Involves no responsibility or authority for the direction of others.

Nature and Scope

External contacts include a variety of third party payers, medical organizations, patients and other healthcare personnel.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Maintain scheduling and tracking systems for long-acting injectable HIV medications.
  • Coordinate with clinical staff and specialty pharmacies to ensure timely medication procurement and dosing.
  • Monitor injection schedules and proactively address potential delays or barriers to care.
  • Assist with patient reminders, appointment confirmations, and follow-up outreach to reduce missed visits.
  • Perform patient check-in and check-out procedures.
  • Verify insurance eligibility and obtain necessary authorizations.
  • Coordinate referrals and follow up to ensure continuity of care.
  • Document patient interactions and care coordination activities in the Electronic Medical Record (EMR).
  • Support reporting initiatives related to patient engagement and viral suppression outcomes.
  • Collaborate with providers, nurses, case managers, and pharmacy partners.
  • Maintain accurate and confidential patient records.
  • Assist with daily clinic workflows to ensure efficient operations.
  • Support quality improvement initiatives and performance reporting.

Core Competencies

  • Attention to detail
  • Patient engagement and communication
  • Care coordination
  • Confidentiality and HIPAA compliance
  • Team collaboration
  • Problem-solving and proactive follow-up

Minimum Requirements

  • Current certification as a Medical Assistant (CMA or equivalent).
  • High school diploma or equivalent (Associate degree preferred).
  • Minimum 1–2 years of experience in a clinical or healthcare setting (HIV or infectious disease experience preferred).
  • Experience with EMR systems.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Commitment to patient-centered care and health equity.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos. Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação. A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles. Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer.

M3 Global Research maintains ISO 20252 and 27001 certifications, delivering high‑quality data collection and project management capabilities covering quantitative and qualitative techniques.

Job Description

M3 Global Research, an M3 company, is looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can thrive in a fast‑paced environment developing complex applications. The candidate will demonstrate an understanding of software development concepts, lifecycles using Agile methodologies, object‑oriented design, and accepted design patterns and practices. Responsibilities include

  • Lead and supervise the development team, ensuring projects are executed efficiently, aligned with Agile methodologies, and meet quality standards.

  • Participate in and facilitate Agile ceremonies, such as daily stand‑ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.

Qualifications

  • Strong expertise in Node.js, with experience building scalable and efficient backend systems and APIs.

  • Exposure to additional languages and frameworks such as PL/SQL, Java/JSP, jQuery, HTML5, CSS3, PHP, Ruby, and ColdFusion is beneficial.
  • Proficient with source control tools like Git for collaborative development and versioning.

  • Team‑oriented with exceptional collaboration and communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • Exceptional multitasking abilities, capable of balancing multiple projects and priorities effectively.
  • An analytical mindset with superior problem‑solving abilities and a strong inclination to learn and implement new techniques.
  • Familiarity with mobile‑first development and responsive design is a plus.

AI and Automation Expectations

  • Strong hands‑on experience with modern AI models and coding tools that improve development velocity and software quality.
  • Ability to apply AI across the Node.js lifecycle, including implementation, refactoring, debugging, and unit/integration test creation.
  • Experience using AI to strengthen CI/CD and quality engineering practices (test generation, flaky test analysis, release validation, and review support).
  • Proven ability to design or integrate automation that increases team efficiency, reduces repetitive work, and improves delivery consistency.
  • Practical understanding of model selection, prompt strategy, output validation, and safe handling of proprietary or sensitive information.
  • Evidence of measurable outcomes from AI‑enabled engineering (faster delivery cycles, stronger test posture, and reduced production defects).

Additional Information

Software Engineer, Sustaining Engineering for a fast‑paced engineering role in Linux‑based software‑defined infrastructure and applications. This is a remote role; we have teams in all time zones.

  • Resolving complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software
  • Maintaining a close working relationship with Canonical's Field, Support and product engineering teams
  • Participating in upstream communities
  • Developing bug fixes, backporting patches, and working with upstream for inclusion
  • Reviewing code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrating good judgement in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritizing work and managing your time effectively against those priorities
  • Participating in team discussions to improve processes, tools, and documentation
  • Maintaining clear, technical and concise communications
  • Working from home and traveling internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences
  • Helping with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu

Qualifications

  • Professional experience as a software engineer
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Strong experience with Linux, and at least one of the following:
    • Ceph, OpenStack, Kubernetes or other cloud technologies
  • Strong development‑level experience with at least one of Python, Go, C or C++ on Linux
  • Ability to troubleshoot with debugging tools like gdb
  • Familiarity with git source code repositories and branches
  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Nice‑to‑have skills

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self‑motivated
  • You have interest in, and experience with most of the following: Ubuntu Linux - kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD, Python, Go, C, Postgresql, Mongo, Debian packaging, distributed systems

Benefits

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person – we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer.

As atividades listadas são as principais, mas o trabalho pode incluir outras atividades similares no dia a dia.

title: MPD Supervisor
description:
Descrição do Cargo

Reports to: Drilling Superintendent

Offshore Drilling Group

Pre-Requisite / Qualification

  • High School Diploma (U.S.) / Proof of Completion of Formal Education or Relevant Craft Certificate (where applicable)
  • Successful Military Discharge – Preferred for U.S.
  • Graduate of Trade School or University where knowledge and training acquired are applicable to job requirements – Preferred
  • Valid medical examination and vaccination certificates
  • Knowledge of all technical calculations required for the safe operation within the drilling operations.
  • Valid Well Control certificate per the standard defined on the training matrix
  • Ability to use hydraulic modelling software.
  • Computer literate including a high level of competence in Microsoft Office.
  • Require 5+ years Offshore MPD Experience
  • OEM Managed Pressure Drilling operations training

General Requirements

  • Promotes a safe and respectful work environment: proactively promotes and maintains open and transparent dialogue between all levels of personnel.
  • Demonstrates care for the safety and well‑being of all personnel, invests in each person to provide equal opportunity for development and advancement.
  • Attends and participates in all required Safety and Operational meetings.
  • Participates fully in the annual performance appraisal process, competency assessments based on performance against Operational Discipline requirements.
  • Completes company training requirements for the MPD Supervisor job level as per the training matrix, including local and regulatory requirements.
  • Observes duties and responsibilities in the safety case for this position.
  • Fully participates in emergency drills and responds to emergency situations as per assigned duties on the station bill.

Operational Discipline Requirements

  • Disciplined application and participation in the Task Planning & Risk Assessment Process.
  • Performs roles and responsibilities as assigned at the pre‑job meeting.
  • Understands hazards associated with the task.
  • Effectively implements control measures required to mitigate identified hazards.
  • Executes all tasks and task steps in a disciplined manner, following the sequence detailed in the relevant procedures.
  • Recognises risky behaviour or conditions during tasks and calls ‘Time out for Safety’ when unsure.
  • Participates in After Action Reviews to provide feedback and updates to the MPD manager.
  • Reports deviations from TOI procedures when using third‑party MPD procedures.

HSE Requirements

  • Reports all incidents, potential hazards or abnormal situations to supervisors.
  • Actively performs work in accordance with Company Safety Processes, e.g. START, Task Planning Risk Assessment, Prompt Card, Safe Manual Handling, Working at Heights.
  • Calls Time Out for Safety (TOFS) when the plan is unclear or an unsafe condition is observed.
  • Participates in the rigs ‘Hold the Zero’ plan.
  • Complies with company requirements to safeguard lone workers.
  • Maintains a safe and organised work area throughout all tasks.
  • Integrates the Task Planning and Risk Assessment process into all tasks.
  • Ensures subordinate personnel are trained in the START and PTW processes.
  • Communicates Company QHSE policies and programmes to and ensures they are understood by all personnel.
  • Acts in weekly meetings, FOCUS Improvement Program, and other company safety management systems.
  • Maintains high hygiene and housekeeping standards in areas of responsibility.
  • Ensures subordinates understand their roles in the Emergency Response Plan.
  • Performs required well‑control drills, conducts After Action Reviews and ensures findings are communicated.
  • Ensures DROPS inspections are conducted per the rig’s inspection programme.
  • Participates in MPD HazOp, HazID and FMECA as required by the MPD manager.

Duties

The underlying expectation is that all duties are carried out in compliance with the Company Operational Discipline expectations and HSE requirements.

Operations / Maintenance

  • Fully knowledgeable in all aspects of MPD operations on floating drilling vessels and MPD variants.
  • Prepares operational procedures approved by the MPD manager and secures approval for changes.
  • Performs all calculations for Kick Tolerance, IME and updates the Operations Matrix.
  • Ensures all BHA and pipe tallies are accurate, with required information entered into the MPD model.
  • Monitors maintenance, repair and installation of all MPD equipment and records inventory levels.
  • Maintains inspection and certification records for MPD equipment and tools.
  • Supports the Company Rig Maintenance System (AIM) for MPD department tasks with subsea.
  • Reviews and approves all MPD‑related Permit to Work as the responsible person for the task.
  • Supervises equipment preparation for impending MPD operations.
  • Liaises with the MPD manager on major maintenance activities such as IRJ 12‑month inspection.
  • When using the rig’s existing MGS, ensures the IME, Ops Matrix and procedures capture the maximum flow rates with a 100% safety factor.
  • Plans job activities of MPD service providers and associated activities.
  • Ensures MPD well‑control requirements are in place and supervises well‑control events.
  • Performs all MPD well‑control calculations (e.g., mud weight, circulating pressures, strokes).
  • Assists the Drilling Superintendent, Senior Toolpusher or OIM in coordinating third‑party personnel activities.
  • Prepares requisition purchase orders for equipment or parts necessary to avoid MPD downtime.
  • Ensures sufficient stock of parts and materials is maintained for MPD equipment.
  • Communicates progress of MPD and associated operations to the Drilling Superintendent, Senior Toolpusher and OIM.
  • Recommends adjustments to drilling parameters to improve MPD performance.
  • Ensures regular effective well‑MPD drills are conducted and recorded.

Personnel

  • Promotes and maintains good relationships with other departments, third‑party personnel and customer representatives.
  • Ensures MPD personnel meet training requirements per their training matrix.
  • Mentors, coaches, develops and trains crew members for MPD competence.
  • Provides leadership and motivation to drilling crews during MPD operations and applies continuous improvement.
  • Mentors the driller and assistant driller in MPD operations.
  • Carrying out MPD operations in alignment with TOI MPD training philosophy.
  • Assists in training to ensure all personnel are competent for their assigned jobs.
  • Participates fully in the annual performance appraisal process.
  • Applies appropriate accountability regarding recognition, promotion or disciplinary actions up to and including discharge.

title: Especialista de Inteligência e Relacionamento com Autoridades - Rio de Janeiro (RJ)
description:
Por que a Gabriel?

16.500 câmeras. 90 milhões de leituras de placa por mês. 1 alerta por minuto direto para a polícia. 650+ suspeitos indiciados. No Rio, nossa rede protege bairros inteiros com tecnologia integrada às forças policiais. Aqui você não apenas trabalha com tecnologia, você transforma dados em vidas protegidas e reduz a impunidade em cidades onde a segurança é direito de todos.

Por que essa vaga existe?

Nossa operação no Rio processa alto volume de demandas de delegacias, batalhões e guarda municipal. Absorver esse volume com agilidade, sem comprometer qualidade, é o desafio central dessa posição. Você será responsável por analisar ocorrências em tempo real, preparar evidências que aceleram investigações e garantir que cada alerta chega à polícia registrado, rastreável e pronto para ação.

Como a Gabriel remunera?

  • Nossa Remuneração: de R$150.800 a R$226.200 /ano (incluindo 13º salário e férias)
  • Nossos Benefícios (mais de R$35.000 anuais em benefícios):
    • Cuidado completo com a sua Saúde de maneira integral:
    • Plano de Saúde Alice com atendimento 24h pelo app, cobertura nacional e acesso a hospitais de referência no país - e sem coparticipação para os colaboradores. Cobrimos também 80% do valor dos seus dependentes.
    • Plano Odontológico da Odontoprev, para cuidar do seu sorriso e dos seus dependentes sem coparticipação.
    • Totalpass TP+1 custeado integralmente para você - para quem corre, caminha, "puxa ferro", faz yoga ou quem quer começar a se cuidar. Você pode adicionar até três dependentes.
    • Reembolso Saúde Mental: para cuidar também da sua saúde mental, reembolsamos até R$ 100,00 por sessão de psicoterapia.
    • Alimentação: Cada refeição importa, e a gente sabe. Oferecemos vale-refeição no Cartão Caju de R$ 922,00 por mês.
    • Benefício Educação: Seu crescimento impulsiona o nosso: reembolsamos 50% do valor que você investe na sua educação, limitado a até R$ 4.000/ano.
    • Auxílio Creche: Crianças de até 5 anos e 11 meses têm direito a auxílio-creche, para você poder focar no seu trabalho sabendo que quem você ama está bem cuidado.
    • Descanso de Aniversário, para você curtir sua data especial como preferir.

Responsabilidades principais

  • Análise de ocorrências é o coração do trabalho
    • Fornecer às autoridades competentes informações técnicas que aceleram investigações e ajudam a dar resposta concreta à sociedade - sem nunca substituir o trabalho investigativo, que é da autoridade pública;
    • Absorver alto volume de demandas simultâneas com agilidade, sem comprometer a qualidade - no RJ, o ritmo é intenso e a capacidade de priorização faz toda a diferença;
    • Acompanhar e registrar desfechos - cada suspeito indiciado, cada pessoa encontrada, cada caso resolvido com apoio das nossas imagens é uma métrica de impacto real.
  • Atendimento institucional a autoridades públicas
    • Atender demandas de delegacias, batalhões, Guardas Municipais e demais órgãos de segurança no RJ, recebendo e processando solicitações conforme os protocolos da empresa;
    • Apoiar o time existente na gestão do fluxo de atendimento, garantindo que o aumento de volume não comprometa prazos nem padrão de entrega;
    • Participar de Conselhos Comunitários de Segurança e espaços institucionais quando necessário, representando a Gabriel de forma transparente;
    • Reportar à liderança de Relações Institucionais e Governamentais, contribuindo com insumos operacionais para o planejamento da área.
  • Compliance como base de tudo
    • Garantir que toda interação com autoridades siga os protocolos formais da empresa: canais corporativos, ofício válido, registro em HubSpot, compartilhamento por link restrito;
    • Manter padrão de documentação que suporte auditoria - todas as comunicações são individualizadas, rastreáveis e revisadas periodicamente.
  • Colaboração com o time
    • Trabalhar junto ao time do RJ e à Central 24h, garantindo fluidez entre os casos que chegam por diferentes canais;
    • Contribuir com melhorias nos processos operacionais - quem está na linha de frente com volume alto é quem melhor enxerga gargalos e oportunidades;
    • Capacitar equipes internas quando necessário, compartilhando conhecimento sobre dinâmicas de segurança e boas práticas de análise.

O que esperamos de você

  • Experiência comprovada em análise de ocorrências, análise de vídeos ou avaliação de riscos em contexto de segurança;
  • Experiência em interação com autoridades públicas de segurança (Polícia Civil, Polícia Militar, Guarda Municipal ou equivalentes), com atuação pautada por protocolos formais;
  • Capacidade analítica forte e habilidade de priorizar sob pressão com alto volume de demandas simultâneas - esse é o diferencial central da posição;
  • Agilidade na execução sem perda de qualidade: a pessoa precisa ser rápida e precisa ao mesmo tempo;
  • Comunicação excelente, tanto escrita (documentação, relatórios, devolutivas a autoridades) quanto oral (interação com delegacias e times internos);
  • Proficiência em ferramentas de análise e edição de vídeo;
  • Segundo grau completo; bacharelado em Gestão de Riscos, Gestão de Segurança, Direito, Engenharia ou áreas afins será um diferencial.

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de segurança pública do Rio de Janeiro.

Comandante – GOL Linhas Aéreas – Rio de Janeiro

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Missão do Cargo

Exercer a autoridade de Comandante desde a apresentação para o voo até a entrega da aeronave ao final da viagem, garantindo a Segurança operacional, a conformidade regulatória e a continuidade das operações e representando a empresa perante passageiros, tripulação e autoridades, em alinhamento ao Código Brasileiro de Aeronáutica (CBA) e aos regulamentos vigentes.

Além disso, atuar em integração com os Times da Companhia, contribuindo com sua experiência para o fortalecimento contínuo da operação.

Autoridade

  • Exercer autoridade plena sobre a aeronave, tripulação, passageiros e carga durante toda a operação
  • Recusar aeronave que não esteja em condições aeronavegáveis
  • Adiar, suspender ou encerrar o voo quando indispensável à Segurança
  • Recusar embarque ou determinar desembarque de pessoas que comprometam a Segurança ou a disciplina a bordo
  • Adotar medidas necessárias à proteção da aeronave, das pessoas e dos bens transportados
  • Representar o Administrador da empresa durante toda a viagem
  • Atuar em ocorrências relacionadas a atos ilícitos (AVSEC), mantendo comunicação com os órgãos de controle
  • Contratar manutenção extraordinária, quando necessário
  • Validar licenças e certificados, conforme prerrogativa da autoridade aeronáutica

Segurança Operacional

  • Garantir a Segurança de tripulantes, passageiros e carga do fechamento das portas até o desembarque final
  • Assegurar as condições de aeronavegabilidade, peso e balanceamento
  • Certificar-se da correta quantidade de combustível e monitorar seu consumo
  • Avaliar as condições meteorológicas, NOTAMs e dos aeródromos
  • Garantir que o voo esteja devidamente despachado junto ao DOV
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos procedimentos do Programa de Segurança do Operador Aéreo
  • Reportar condições inseguras aos órgãos de controle e à área de Safety
  • Identificar e reportar perigos operacionais por meio do sistema oficial da empresa

Gestão da Tripulação

  • Assegurar a subordinação técnica e disciplinar da tripulação
  • Delegar atribuições, exceto aquelas relacionadas à Segurança do voo
  • Definir o Pilot Flying e garantir a execução correta dos checklists
  • Garantir que apenas atividades essenciais sejam realizadas em fases críticas do voo
  • Zelar pelo cumprimento da regulamentação profissional, incluindo jornada, repouso e limites operacionais

Conformidade e Registros

  • Preencher ou assegurar o correto preenchimento do Diário de Bordo e do Relatório Técnico da Aeronave
  • Registrar ocorrências que demandem inspeção obrigatória, como pouso duro, turbulência severa, tail strike, RTO, incidência de raio e excedentes de limites operacionais
  • Assegurar os registros de ocorrências a bordo, incluindo eventos médicos, nascimentos e óbitos, conforme regulamentação aplicável
  • Garantir o cumprimento das diretrizes de Segurança Operacional (SGSO) e da Política Ambiental

Cabine e Passageiros

  • Assegurar a transmissão das instruções de Segurança
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas de Segurança em situações normais, de emergência e em evacuação
  • Assegurar a integridade e a Segurança da cabine de comando
  • Garantir a correta utilização dos equipamentos de emergência

Requisitos e qualificações

Não pode faltar em sua bagagem:

Experiência

Experiência de 5 anos na função e na aeronave A330

Certificações Obrigatórias

  • Licença de Piloto de Linha Aérea (PLA)
  • Certificado de Habilitação Técnica (CHT) para o Airbus A330
  • Certificado Médico Aeronáutico (CMA) válido
  • Passaporte brasileiro válido por mais de 6 (seis) meses
  • Vistos americanos B1, B2 e D válidos

Conhecimentos Técnicos

  • Regulamentação aeronáutica aplicável (RBAC 121 e CBA)
  • Sistema de Gerenciamento de Segurança Operacional (SGSO)
  • Procedimentos operacionais da aeronave A330
  • Operação de aeronaves widebody e voos de longo curso

Idiomas

Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils, creating a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations.

Our culture blends people-first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

In this role, you will be a key contributor to our laboratory operations, ensuring analytical processes are executed with precision, consistency, and scientific rigor to support InPlanet’s mission of large-scale carbon removal.

The impact you can make: Your work connects our field operations to scientific validation, generating reliable, high-quality data to ensure our CO2 removal measurements are credible and scalable. You can be a Rock‑Star if you have

Bonus Points (but not essential)

  • Specialization, post‑graduate degree, or equivalent certification in related fields

Living Our Values

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

  • Avaliar e consolidar as informações contidas nos relatórios técnicos e administrativos das Unidades de Saúde da sua área de abrangência, e demais informações necessárias e encaminhar para a consolidação da estatística global da Secretaria Municipal de Saúde;

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: Accommodation Coordinator
description:
Accommodation Coordinator

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

Reporting organizationally to the Accommodation Manager in Rio de Janeiro, the Accommodation Coordinator will help serve Accommodation efforts for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ is hosting 32 teams and 700+ players across Brazil and 8 host cities/ venues. This role will be responsible for coordinating lodging and hotel-related arrangements for the event, ensuring a smooth and comfortable experience for teams, participants and attendees. Further, this role will have a range of responsibilities, including contracting hotels, coordinating inventory, F&B, AV, meetings space, and reconciling and reporting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Contract hotels ensuring they meet quality standards and core group requirements
  • Ensure hotels comply with all contractual obligations
  • Execute tasks and addendums necessary for adjustments to hotel contracts
  • Coordinate reservations, rooming lists, changes and requests for core groups
  • Provide excellent customer service to official tournament guests
  • Coordinate hotel room blocks, meeting space, F&B, AV, group requirements, hotel communications and reservation management
  • Provide resources and information to guests, create presentation materials
  • Support booking and reservation processes for guests
  • Keep all necessary internal and external reporting up to date
  • Ensure held inventory is in accordance with remaining demand
  • Attend site visits, familiarize with hotels and tour constituent groups
  • Coordinate the reconciliation, billing and closeout at hotels and with groups
  • Support and address unforeseen changes, cancellations, or emergencies in accommodation arrangements
  • Build strong relationships with designated groups to provide excellent experience within the overall accommodation strategy
  • Consider all operational aspects when coordinating hotel arrangements, for example, transportation, logistics, security, etc.
  • Uphold and enforce high standards of customer service, ensuring participants and guests have a memorable and enjoyable experience during their stay
  • Establish relationships with the hotel industry to provide the best overall value for FIFA
  • Ensure records of accommodation bookings, rooming lists, and related information comply with data integrity and protection regulations
  • Coordinate various ancillary projects taking place in the leadup to the Women’s World Cup

Your Profile

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree or similar level of education.
  • Minimum of 2 years of work experience in the hospitality industry.
  • Strong communication skills – oral and written.
  • Experience coordinating complex projects.
  • Strong organizational, customer service and attention to detail.
  • Fluent/Native in English and Portuguese are required for this position.
  • Knowledge of other languages is considered a plus.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.

Requirements

  • Must have legal right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to relocate and work from Rio de Janeiro.
  • Required language skills: fluent in English and Portuguese is mandatory, fluent in Spanish is a big plus.

title: Sr Geoscience Consultant
description:
The Role

Reporting to the Director of Onsite Subsurface Science and Engineering (SSE) services, the Senior Geoscience Consultant will be responsible for delivering dedicated and onsite services to a large National Oil Company.

The successful candidate for this key role will be part of an early adopter program, tasked with ensuring a continuous and evolving customer adoption of a cloud-native, AI agentic-ready environment to accelerate subsurface projects that operate on industry standard (OSDU) data structures to automate workflows and accelerate subsurface decision‑making.

In this role, the successful candidate will work closely with oil company geoscientists to define, implement, and execute repeatable workstreams that will improve customer productivity and accelerate and qualify upstream decisions. Workstreams can include project screening and evaluation of data, new venture workflows for rapid prospect evaluation and review, rapid and highly integrated structural and facies model building, and uncertainty screening. AI‑assisted queries can be applied to all workflows.

Responsibilities

  • Work closely with customer geoscientists in building, executing, refining, and documenting workstreams that improve customer decision making, and productivity.
  • Ensure continuous and optimized customer use of an agentic AI software solution to conduct and execute those workstreams.
  • Provide loyalty‑inspiring on‑site customer services that drive user engagement and sustain product usage.
  • Document customer successes and pain points and communicate them to project managers, R&D, and service personnel.
  • Develop an understanding of customer business challenges and requirements.
  • Manage customer expectations and relationships through regular meetings and communications.
  • Prepare and present technical reports, presentations, and recommendations to customer and to AspenTech stakeholders.
  • Work in close collaboration with your supervisor, customer geoscientists, and colleagues to ensure effective coordination and successful delivery of project activities.
  • Conduct projects through final delivery and report writing.

What You'll Need

  • 5 to 8 years of industry experience as a Geomodeller and Geologist in the oil and gas industry.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Geology, Computational Geology, Structural Geology or related Geoscience discipline.
  • Experience in defining structural, stratigraphic, and depositional frameworks and identifying trap geometries and reservoir distribution.
  • Experience in building geomodels including structural models, property models, and facies models.
  • Working understanding seismic interpretation, reservoir characterization, and petrophysical analysis workflows.
  • Experience with applying AI methods to subsurface projects.
  • Experience with or knowledge of industry open platforms like OSDU.
  • Experience with operating application software in a Cloud, considered a plus.
  • Ability to navigate smoothly within modern application software interfaces, incorporating multi‑tasking of activities and operations.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills to resolve complex technical issues and capability to prioritize tasks.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, to convey complex technical concepts to a variety of audiences.
  • Ability to identify opportunities that create value for customers with a strong customer first mindset.
  • Ability to proactively take the lead in resolving complex technical issues and/or difficult organisational problems with an innovative approach.
  • Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and competing priorities.
  • Experience with Python scripting considered a plus.
  • Experience with Formation Evaluation Solutions (e.g., Geolog), Seismic Characterization Solutions (e.g., SeisEarth), and Geomodelling solutions (e.g., SKUA, RMS) from AspenTech considered a plus.

title: Translation Project Manager
description:
Translation Project Manager

Department: Administration

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil.

THE POSITION

The Translation Project Manager of the FIFA27 Language Centre team works in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich key collaborators and other key individuals responsible for delivering the most engaging, innovative, multilingual and accessible World Cup experience for all athletes, fans, partners, and the community.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Managing and supervising the translation services provided by the FWWC27 office to all stakeholders.
  • Handling any issues that arise in connection with the translation services provided by the FWWC27 office.
  • Planning the language operations for the FWWC27 (pre-tournament and during the competition).
  • Reporting on daily business (e.g., requests processed) to the Head of the Language Centre in Zurich.
  • Ensuring a smooth collaboration and efficient processes between FIFA and the FWWC27 office in connection with the translation services provided.
  • Identifying and using artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to streamline processes and increase productivity.
  • Strengthening FIFA’s translation vendor network in the Americas if operations require so.
  • Being the first point of contact for translation requests placed by the FWWC27 team and other FIFA stakeholders.
  • Handling requests in FIFA’s translation management system.
  • Allocating resources.
  • Coordinating large multilingual projects comprised of several requests (CMS/CXM, apps, publications), occasionally managing different teams (developers, graphic designers, desktop publishers).
  • Monitoring and controlling translation requests.

YOUR PROFILE

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree or similar level of education in translation/localization/language technology studies.
  • At least five years’ experience as translation/localization project manager working with a state-of-the-art translation management system.
  • Team player.
  • Ability to set priorities and work under high pressure.
  • Openness and interest to learn.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industries is a plus.
  • Native speaker of Brazilian Portuguese, full professional competency in English (written and oral); proficiency in French and/or Spanish is a plus.
  • At least two years’ experience as a translation/localization project manager working with Trados.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams) and experienced in the use of online planning and collaboration tools.
  • Experience working in global language teams, with different time zones.

Requirements

  • Must have legal right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to relocate and work from Rio de Janeiro.
  • Required language skills: fluent in English and Portuguese is mandatory, fluent in Spanish is a big plus.

description:

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC2027), the first time the tournament will be hosted in South America.

Department

Commercial & Marketing

Location

Brazil

Position

Reporting organizationally to the Head of Marketing, Brand and Promotion (FIFA27, Rio de Janeiro) and the Head of Digital Marketing (FIFA HQ, Zurich), the Senior Digital Marketing Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Marketing, Brand and Promotion team, collaborating with the Digital Marketing teams in Zurich and across Brazil to plan, manage and deliver digital marketing campaigns for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

Key Responsibilities

  • Developing, implementing, and managing multi‑channel digital marketing strategies that align with business, tournament and marketing and communication objectives, ensuring integration across owned digital channels (website, social media, CRM and mobile apps).
  • Coordinating with FIFA’s global digital marketing team to ensure alignment of local campaigns with overall strategies and objectives.
  • Collaborating with tournament stakeholders, including Host Cities and Stadiums, Commercial Partners, and Official Media Partners and Licensees to amplify digital campaigns.
  • Leading alignment with internal functional areas and external stakeholders to ensure cohesive marketing strategies, providing clear communication and expectations across all parties involved.
  • Overseeing the creation, curation, and distribution of engaging digital content that resonates with local and global audiences in support of marketing activity.
  • Ensuring all digital content follows FIFA Women’s World Cup brand guidelines and maintains a consistent tone of voice.
  • Monitoring and analysing the performance of digital campaigns using various analytics tools.
  • Providing regular reports and insights to the global team and other stakeholders.
  • Optimising campaigns based on data‑driven insights to improve engagement and conversion rates.
  • Acting as the primary digital marketing liaison between the Zurich‑based global team and the Brazilian‑based local tournament and event teams.
  • Maintaining strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring seamless communication and collaboration.
  • Supporting Host Cities and Stadiums, Commercial Partners and Media Partners with tailored digital marketing strategies to enhance local engagement.
  • Staying up to date with the latest digital marketing trends and technologies.

Education & Qualifications

  • Related bachelor’s degree or a similar level of higher education.

Work Experience

  • Proven experience (5‑7 years) in managing large‑scale digital marketing campaigns, preferably in sports or entertainment and in the South American market.

Additional Skills

  • Digital Platform Expertise: strong understanding of social media platforms and trends, mobile‑app marketing, web content and email marketing.
  • Strategic Thinking: capacity to think long‑term and align marketing efforts with overall business objectives.
  • Project Management: ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely execution and delivery.
  • Technical & Proficiency Skills: proficiency in using digital marketing and analytics tools (e.g., Adobe Analytics, SEO tools, CRM software, social‑media analytics platforms such as Sprinklr) to interpret data, analyse metrics and make data‑driven decisions.
  • SEO/SEM Knowledge: understanding of search engine optimisation and search engine marketing techniques.
  • Problem‑Solving: proactive approach to identifying challenges and finding solutions in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Result‑Oriented: focusing on achieving measurable outcomes and meeting organisational goals.
  • Decision Making: quick to identify issues and make swift decisions in critical situations, taking initiative and assessing risks effectively.
  • Strong Communication Skills: ability to convey ideas clearly and collaborate effectively with team members and stakeholders.
  • Fan/Customer‑Centric Mindset: skilled at understanding fan/customer needs and tailoring marketing strategies accordingly.
  • Budget Management: experience in managing budgets and allocating resources effectively.
  • Market Knowledge: knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets, culture and trends.

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual – Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.
